name: whid
description: Understand repository changes, trace their impact, and learn unfamiliar projects with evidence from code.

interface.longDescription: AI wrote the code. Make sure you understand it. WHID explains what changed, how it works, why it matters, and what else it affects. Quick provides a focused ownership recap; Deep adds Before/After behavior, execution flow, architecture reasoning, test evidence, and contextual learning questions. Explicit multi-repository analysis connects provider contracts and consumer expectations using repository evidence. Onboard builds an ordered project learning guide, with optional saved chapter refresh and resume. Open source under Apache-2.0. Requires a coding-agent environment with Git and repository access. This is the 0.2.0-alpha.2 prerelease; cross-agent release certification is pending. Quick/Deep are read-only. Saved Onboard writes only to an explicitly requested report directory. Tests require a separate request. WHID operates through your existing agent and has no WHID-operated backend.
defaultPrompt: Use WHID to explain my working-tree changes.
Use WHID to deeply explain my latest commit.
Use WHID to analyze changes across all repositories in this workspace.
